_spec.purpose: The caption variety engine, plus the corpus the comma ceiling will be computed from.
_spec.why: An opening move is the most repeatable thing in a caption, and a machine will find one that scores well and use it forever. Each shipped caption records its opening move and structure so the caption room can be told what is off the table.
_spec.comma_ceiling: NOT SET. It is computed from this product's first twenty shipped captions at ten percent below their measured mean, never copied from another product. config/parity_map.yaml carries the unblock condition; scripts/carousel/caption_check.py measures the rate every run.
_spec.doctrine: knowledge/carousel/CAPTION_CRAFT.md holds the menus this ledger rotates: ten opening moves, eight structures, five closing moves, and the anti-template law the critic judges by.
_spec.exclusions_handed_to_the_room: opening moves from the last 6 runs, structures from the last 3. The room is told what is off the table before it writes, never after.

entry_schema.opening_move: one of the named moves in CAPTION_CRAFT.md
entry_schema.first_line: the actual first line, VERBATIM. Stored because the critic's real job is catching a sentence skeleton that survived a change of nouns, and it can only do that with the real lines in front of it
entry_schema.commas_per_100w: measured by caption_check.py, never typed. This is the corpus the ceiling will be computed from

_spec.recent_lists_note: These three lists are the exclusions handed to the caption room and they were hand-kept. On 2026-08-20 the fourth panel found structures_recent reading ["ledger", "pivot", "question and answer"] when the last three shipped structures were ["ledger", "two columns", "question and answer"], so it dropped a structure that IS off the table and held one that is not. Wrong in both directions from one hand edit. They are now recomputed from entries and are ordered OLDEST FIRST, matching the entries list, and scripts/carousel/caption_check.py should derive them rather than read them. That is an upgrade-lane change and it is written into this run's proposals.

entries.name_note: NORMALISED TO THE MENU at the eighth panel, which found all three names were coined freehand and appear nowhere in CAPTION_CRAFT.md. They read 'the flat statement of the finding', 'chronology, then the charge, then what the charge leaves out' and 'name the page the record was fetched from'. The caption did not change and did not need to: 'Texas authorized what was already driving' puts the old state of the world and the new one in one line, the body is ordered by date, and the close points at the record without asking for anything. All three of those are on the menu and none was excluded. A run that coins a name each day hands the next six runs an exclusion list that excludes nothing, which is how a variety engine quietly stops being one.

entries.critic_note: Two directors wrote against the same closing move because the exclusion list left only two, and the critic said so rather than waving it through. B won because it DEMONSTRATES the limit on one row the reader has just met while A ASSERTS it as a general statement. A also declared 'the number that is wrong' and never corrected a number: its real turn was 'the correction', which shipped on 2026-08-18 and was excluded.

entries.first_line: Four abatements never got a vote. The item they all stood on failed first.
entries.critic_note: Two directors, opposed assignments. The winner opens on Brazoria's four abatements dying on a vote about none of them, which is a procedural fact a reader has no prior for, and only then widens to the seven. The loser opened on the count and narrowed, which is the shape three of the six shipped captions already use. caption_check reported first person on the winner because a period is a word boundary and I.3 matched \\bI\\b, and the gate was repaired in the upgrade lane rather than the caption reworded around a false positive. Round 4 renamed all three moves. They had been written freehand ('the procedural fact nobody expects', 'one case in full, then the pattern it belongs to', 'put the reader's own judgement on the instrument') and none of the three was on a CAPTION_CRAFT menu, which is exactly how they cleared an exclusion list that held all three. The choices were legal, the names were not, and a list can only exclude a name it shares.

entries.closing_move: ask the one question the decision leaves open
entries.critic_note:
TWO NAMING CALLS RECORDED RATHER THAN HIDDEN. The opening is named 'the number that is wrong', whose menu entry reads 'opens on a figure the reader will misjudge, then corrects it', and 'The billion buys no building' is exactly that. A judge read it as 'the correction', which is on the last six exclusion list, and the two doors are genuinely close. The distinction taken is that the correction's own example carries no figure and this line's subject IS the figure. The structure is 'ledger', what is known then what is not known then the size of the gap, which is the caption's actual order.

AND THE CLOSE REPEATS 08-25, WHICH THE EXCLUSION LIST COULD NOT HAVE PREVENTED. ledger_check derives closing_moves_recent from the entries BEFORE the newest, so while 08-25 was the newest its own closing move was excluded from the list by design and today's room was never handed it. Rolling it forward by hand made this file disagree with its own entries and turned shipped_check red on the already published 08-25 run, which is the gate working rather than failing. The room needs the lists derived INCLUDING the newest SHIPPED entry, with only the unshipped run's own entry held out. Upgrade lane, written down rather than hand edited.
